def weighted_quantiles(values, weights, probs=(0.10, 0.50, 0.90)): if not values: return ["", "", ""] v = np.asarray(values, dtype=np.float64) w = np.asarray(weights, dtype=np.float64) ok = np.isfinite(v) & np.isfinite(w) & (w > 0) if not np.any(ok): return ["", "", ""] v = v[ok] w = w[ok] order = np.argsort(v) v = v[order] w = w[order] cw = np.cumsum(w) total = float(cw[-1]) out = [] for p in probs: out.append(float(v[np.searchsorted(cw, p * total, side="left")])) return out

class Logger: def __init__(self, path: Path, visum: Any = None) -> None: self.path = path self.visum = visum self.lines: List[str] = []

def _att(obj: Any, names: Sequence[str], default: str = "") -> str: for name in names: for cand in (name, name.upper(), name.lower(), name.title()): try: val = obj.AttValue(cand) if val is not None: return _safe_str(val) except Exception: pass return default
def _set_att(obj: Any, names: Sequence[str], value: Any, log: Optional[Logger] = None, label: str = "") -> bool: for name in names: for cand in (name, name.upper(), name.lower(), name.title()): try: obj.SetAttValue(cand, value) return True except Exception: pass if log is not None: log.log("WARN cannot set %s.%s=%r" % (label, names[0] if names else "attr", value)) return False
def _get_multi(container: Any, attr: str) -> List[Tuple[Any, Any]]: try: return list(container.GetMultiAttValues(attr, False)) except Exception: return list(container.GetMultiAttValues(attr))
def _matrix_numbers(v: Any) -> set: out = set() try: rows = _get_multi(v.Net.Matrices, "NO") for _key, val in rows: try: out.add(int(round(float(val)))) except Exception: pass except Exception: pass return out
def _matrix(v: Any, no: int, existing: Optional[set] = None) -> Any: nums = existing if existing is not None else _matrix_numbers(v) if int(no) not in nums: return None try: return v.Net.Matrices.ItemByKey(int(no)) except Exception: pass # Slow fallback. try: for obj in list(v.Net.Matrices.GetAll): try: if int(round(float(_att(obj, ["NO", "No"], "-1")))) == int(no): return obj except Exception: pass except Exception: pass return None
def _matrix_info(v: Any, no: int) -> Dict[str, Any]: obj = _matrix(v, int(no)) if obj is None: return {"matrix_no": int(no), "exists": "NO"} return { "matrix_no": int(no), "exists": "YES", "code": _att(obj, ["CODE", "Code"], ""), "name": _att(obj, ["NAME", "Name"], ""), "datasourcetype": _att(obj, ["DATASOURCETYPE", "DataSourceType"], ""), "matrixtype": _att(obj, ["MATRIXTYPE", "MatrixType"], ""), "formula": _att(obj, ["FORMULA", "Formula"], ""), }

def _delete_matrix(v: Any, no: int, log: Logger) -> Dict[str, Any]: no = int(no) existing = _matrix(v, no) before = _matrix_info(v, no) row = dict(before) row.update({"delete_status": "NOT_PRESENT", "delete_method": "", "delete_error": ""}) if existing is None: return row
attempts = [] net = v.Net for method_name in ("RemoveMatrix", "DeleteMatrix"): method = getattr(net, method_name, None) if method is not None: attempts.append(("Net.%s(no)" % method_name, lambda m=method: m(no))) attempts.append(("Net.%s(obj)" % method_name, lambda m=method, obj=existing: m(obj))) try: coll = net.Matrices except Exception: coll = None if coll is not None: for method_name in ("Remove", "Delete", "RemoveItem", "DeleteItem"): method = getattr(coll, method_name, None) if method is not None: attempts.append(("Matrices.%s(no)" % method_name, lambda m=method: m(no))) attempts.append(("Matrices.%s(obj)" % method_name, lambda m=method, obj=existing: m(obj))) for method_name in ("Delete", "Remove"): method = getattr(existing, method_name, None) if method is not None: attempts.append(("Matrix(%s).%s()" % (no, method_name), lambda m=method: m()))
errors: List[str] = [] for label, fn in attempts: try: fn() if _matrix(v, no) is None: row.update({"delete_status": "DELETED", "delete_method": label, "delete_error": ""}) log.log("OK deleted Matrix(%s) using %s" % (no, label)) return row errors.append("%s returned but matrix still exists" % label) except Exception as exc: errors.append("%s -> %s" % (label, _short_exc(exc, 200))) row.update({"delete_status": "ERROR", "delete_method": "", "delete_error": " | ".join(errors[:12])}) raise RuntimeError("Cannot delete Matrix(%s): %s" % (no, row["delete_error"]))
def _read_matrix_array(v: Any, no: int) -> np.ndarray: # type: ignore[name-defined] if np is None: raise RuntimeError("numpy is not available in this VISUM Python runtime") obj = _matrix(v, int(no)) if obj is None: raise RuntimeError("Required input Matrix(%s) is missing" % int(no)) arr = np.asarray(obj.GetValues(), dtype=float) if arr.shape != (EXPECTED_ZONES, EXPECTED_ZONES): raise RuntimeError("Matrix(%s) has shape %r, expected (%s,%s)" % (int(no), arr.shape, EXPECTED_ZONES, EXPECTED_ZONES)) if not np.isfinite(arr).all(): raise RuntimeError("Matrix(%s) contains NaN/Inf" % int(no)) if float(arr.min()) < -ZERO_TOL: raise RuntimeError("Matrix(%s) contains negative values, min=%.12g" % (int(no), float(arr.min()))) arr = arr.copy() arr[arr < 0.0] = 0.0 return arr
def _matrix_sum(v: Any, no: int) -> Optional[float]: obj = _matrix(v, int(no)) if obj is None: return None for attr in ("SUM", "Sum", "MATSUM", "MatrixSum", "TOTAL", "Total"): try: val = obj.AttValue(attr) if val is not None: x = float(str(val).replace(",", ".")) if math.isfinite(x): return x except Exception: pass try: arr = np.asarray(obj.GetValues(), dtype=float) if np is not None else None if arr is not None: finite = arr[np.isfinite(arr)] return float(finite.sum()) if finite.size else 0.0 except Exception: pass return None
def _set_matrix_values(obj: Any, arr: np.ndarray) -> str: # type: ignore[name-defined] payloads = [ ("list_of_lists", np.asarray(arr, dtype=float).tolist()), ("tuple_of_tuples", tuple(tuple(float(x) for x in row) for row in np.asarray(arr, dtype=float).tolist())), ] errors: List[str] = [] for label, payload in payloads: try: obj.SetValues(payload) return "SetValues(%s)" % label except Exception as exc: errors.append("%s: %s" % (label, _short_exc(exc, 250))) raise RuntimeError("Cannot SetValues: %s" % " | ".join(errors))
def _hard_sym(a: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray: # type: ignore[name-defined] return 0.5 * (a + a.T)
def _max_abs_offdiag_row_col_gap(a: np.ndarray) -> float: # type: ignore[name-defined] b = np.asarray(a, dtype=float).copy() np.fill_diagonal(b, 0.0) return float(np.max(np.abs(b.sum(axis=1) - b.sum(axis=0))))
def _smart_return_balance(raw: np.ndarray) -> Tuple[np.ndarray, Dict[str, Any]]: # type: ignore[name-defined] n = int(raw.shape[0]) diag = np.diag(raw).copy() off = raw.copy() np.fill_diagonal(off, 0.0)
off_row = off.sum(axis=1) off_col = off.sum(axis=0) target = 0.5 * (off_row + off_col) target_total = float(target.sum())
before_gap = float(np.max(np.abs(off_row - off_col))) if n else 0.0 before_total = float(raw.sum()) diag_total = float(diag.sum()) off_total = float(off.sum())
if target_total <= ZERO_TOL: out = np.zeros_like(raw) np.fill_diagonal(out, diag) return out, { "iterations": 0, "converged": "YES", "input_total": before_total, "output_total": float(out.sum()), "diag_total": diag_total, "offdiag_total": off_total, "target_total_offdiag": 0.0, "max_abs_row_err": 0.0, "max_abs_col_err": 0.0, "max_rel_err": 0.0, "before_max_abs_offdiag_row_col_gap": before_gap, "after_max_abs_offdiag_row_col_gap": 0.0, "seed_positive_cells": 0, "support_added_cells": 0, "support_floor_cells": 0, "support_repair_cells": 0, "support_repair_target_sum": 0.0, }
# V2 support closure: # - keep existing positive OD support; # - add reverse support where the opposite direction exists; # - use a tiny numerical floor so very small reverse OD cells do not fall # under ZERO_TOL after multiplying by SUPPORT_EPSILON. seed = np.zeros_like(off) direct = off > 0.0 reverse_only = (off <= 0.0) & (off.T > 0.0) seed[direct] = np.maximum(off[direct], SUPPORT_FLOOR) if np.any(reverse_only): seed[reverse_only] = np.maximum(SUPPORT_FLOOR, SUPPORT_EPSILON * off.T[reverse_only]) np.fill_diagonal(seed, 0.0)
support_added = int(np.sum(reverse_only)) support_floor_cells = int(np.sum((seed > 0.0) & (seed <= SUPPORT_FLOOR * 1.0000001))) support_repair_cells = 0 support_repair_target_sum = 0.0
row_seed = seed.sum(axis=1) col_seed = seed.sum(axis=0) bad_rows = np.where((target > ZERO_TOL) & (row_seed <= ZERO_TOL))[0] bad_cols = np.where((target > ZERO_TOL) & (col_seed <= ZERO_TOL))[0]

In practice, tiny floating tails # can still create an active target with no support above numerical tolerance. # For those sub-vehicle numerical tails, add minimal support between bad rows # and bad columns. Fail closed if this would affect material demand. if bad_rows.size or bad_cols.size: support_repair_target_sum = float(target[bad_rows].sum() + target[bad_cols].sum()) if support_repair_target_sum > SUPPORT_REPAIR_MAX_TARGET_TOTAL: raise RuntimeError( "IPF infeasible support after V5 repair gate: bad_rows=%s bad_cols=%s repair_target_sum=%.12g" % (bad_rows[:10].tolist(), bad_cols[:10].tolist(), support_repair_target_sum) ) if bad_rows.size and bad_cols.size: for rr in bad_rows: for cc in bad_cols: if rr != cc and seed[int(rr), int(cc)] <= 0.0: seed[int(rr), int(cc)] = SUPPORT_FLOOR support_repair_cells += 1 elif bad_rows.size: active_cols = np.where(target > ZERO_TOL)[0] for rr in bad_rows: for cc in active_cols[:10]: if rr != cc and seed[int(rr), int(cc)] <= 0.0: seed[int(rr), int(cc)] = SUPPORT_FLOOR support_repair_cells += 1 break elif bad_cols.size: active_rows = np.where(target > ZERO_TOL)[0] for cc in bad_cols: for rr in active_rows[:10]: if rr != cc and seed[int(rr), int(cc)] <= 0.0: seed[int(rr), int(cc)] = SUPPORT_FLOOR support_repair_cells += 1 break row_seed = seed.sum(axis=1) col_seed = seed.sum(axis=0) bad_rows = np.where((target > ZERO_TOL) & (row_seed <= ZERO_TOL))[0] bad_cols = np.where((target > ZERO_TOL) & (col_seed <= ZERO_TOL))[0] if bad_rows.size or bad_cols.size: raise RuntimeError("IPF infeasible support after V5 repair: bad_rows=%s bad_cols=%s" % (bad_rows[:10].tolist(), bad_cols[:10].tolist()))
seed_positive = int(np.sum(seed > ZERO_TOL))
x = seed.copy() active = target > ZERO_TOL converged = False max_abs_row_err = float("inf") max_abs_col_err = float("inf") max_rel_err = float("inf") denom = max(target_total, 1.0)
for it in range(1, IPF_MAX_ITER + 1): rows = x.sum(axis=1) row_factor = np.zeros(n, dtype=float) row_factor[active] = target[active] / np.maximum(rows[active], ZERO_TOL) x *= row_factor[:, None]
cols = x.sum(axis=0) col_factor = np.zeros(n, dtype=float) col_factor[active] = target[active] / np.maximum(cols[active], ZERO_TOL) x *= col_factor[None, :]
if it == 1 or it % 10 == 0 or it == IPF_MAX_ITER: rows2 = x.sum(axis=1) cols2 = x.sum(axis=0) max_abs_row_err = float(np.max(np.abs(rows2 - target))) max_abs_col_err = float(np.max(np.abs(cols2 - target))) max_rel_err = max(max_abs_row_err, max_abs_col_err) / denom if max_abs_row_err <= IPF_TOL_ABS and max_abs_col_err <= IPF_TOL_ABS: converged = True break if max_rel_err <= IPF_TOL_REL: converged = True break
